title: How to Make an Intro for Your Game Using AI
author: elcuhhu
selftext:
If you know nothing about video editing but want to make an intro for your game and have no idea where to start, this tutorial might help you!

# Step 1 – tools

You’re going to need a video editing tool that allows you to connect your AI agent, choose one that supports video generation.

For this tutorial, I’m using Picsart, but you can use any alternative you prefer. The reason I’m using Picsart is that it has its own AI agents for video editing , so I don’t have to spend a lot in tokens.

Once you have chosen your editing software, the next step is to connect your AI agent. The exact process depends on which software you use. Open the AI agent available in your chosen software and check which tools it can access. Ideally, you want an agent that can help you generate videos, edit scenes, create visuals, and refine your results using prompts.

# Step 2 – Let your creativity take over

Once you have your AI agent set up, it’s really just a matter of creativity. 

**And if you have no idea what to create, just ask AI!** Tell it about your game and ask it to come up with intro ideas, cinematic concepts, camera movements, and prompts you can use to generate your scenes.

Think about what you want your game intro to look like. Do you want to use your own gameplay footage, or do you want to create something more cinematic, cartoonish really anything.

From there, it’s all about experimenting with prompts until you get a result you’re happy with.

You can do almost anything you can imagine, so don’t be afraid to experiment with different ideas, camera angles, scenes, and styles.
